description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeLicenseDao in the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It defines various tests to verify the behavior of EmployeeLicenseDao methods such as get, save, delete, and search employee licenses, ensuring correct data operations and business logic.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the functionality of EmployeeLicenseDao methods in the OrangeHRM PIM plugin, including CRUD operations and license search capabilities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test setup by instantiating EmployeeLicenseDao and populating test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an employee license by employee and license IDs.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Tests deletion of specified employee licenses.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Verifies searching for employee licenses by employee number.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeLicenseWithLimit
methods.description: Tests the search with a limit on number of results.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Checks saving (creating) a new employee license record.

methods.name: testEditEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Validates updating an existing employee license record.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeLicensesCount
methods.description: Verifies counting employee licenses based on search filters.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAllowedLicenses
methods.description: Tests retrieval of allowed licenses for an employee based on their number.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAllowedLicensesCount
methods.description: Checks count of allowed licenses for specific employees.
